_provenance.source: UK AIP ILS/DME plates AD 2-EGLL-8-1, 8-4, 8-7, 8-10 (AIRAC 10/2026), read from the text layer and render
_provenance.method: Glidepath 3 deg, RDH and missed approach text read from each plate. UK plates print the ILS reference datum height (RDH) where FAA plates print TCH; the AIP AD 2.19 says "3 deg ILS Ref Datum Hgt 51/50/56/58 FT". LOC/DME and RNP charts not read.
_provenance.terms: tch_ft = RDH (ILS reference datum height at the threshold).

missed_approach.plate_text: Climb to 3000 - straight ahead until passing 1580 or I-AA DME zero inbound whichever is later, then left onto track 035°. Continue as directed. RCF: On passing LON DME 10 proceed to NDB CHT at 3000.
